rule: chart slot first (LCB, RCB, CB, NB, NCB, NKL a corner; SS, FS, S a safety: the best-ranked family slot of the player's Week 1 chart rows), then the 2014 weekly-roster label of his latest regular-season week in Weeks 1-4 (CB a corner; S, SS, FS, SAF a safety), then the in-season rails' stated position; never the depth chart's position column or players.csv. A corner's label is CB; a safety keeps his deciding safety label. Nickel: a Week 1 chart NB, NCB or NKL slot at the player's own branch club. No chart in the source labels an outside reserve.

roster_weekly_2014w4.csv.scope: 2014 REG Weeks 1-4, the latest week per player

verification.pass2_family_agreement: 290 library defensive backs, every family the same in both passes

status_quo_nickel_seat.rule: library clubs with five or more Week 1 available defensive backs whose fifth by the library depth order (the 2014.5 nickel seat) is a safety: by the library position label, and by this table's family
